message.content:
Sure! Here are a few kitchen appliances that can bake a chocolate cake:

| Appliance | Why it’s good for cakes | Typical use |
|-----------|------------------------|-------------|
| **Conventional electric oven** | Even heat, precise temperature control, works with any cake pan | Most home bakers use this for classic cakes |
| **Convection oven** | Fan circulates hot air → faster, more even baking | Great if you want a crisp top and don’t want to open the door often |
| **Toaster oven / countertop convection oven** | Compact, energy‑efficient, still gives good results | Ideal for small batches or when you don’t have space for a full oven |
| **Microwave oven** | Quick “microwave cake” mixes work well | Good for a single serving or when you’re short on time |
| **Bread machine with cake setting** | Some bread machines have a “cake” mode that handles mixing and baking | Convenient if you already own one and want a hands‑off option |
| **Slow cooker / crockpot** | Slow, low‑heat baking yields moist cakes | Works best with a cake mix or a homemade batter that’s been pre‑mixed |

If you’re looking for a brand‑specific recommendation, let me know your budget and any preferences (e.g., size, features), and I can suggest a particular model.
